description: ESC character (U+001B) in a string value. RFC 8785 §3.2.2.2 requires that control characters in U+0000-U+001F with no named two-character escape (\b \t \n \f \r) be serialized as \uXXXX with lowercase hexadecimal digits. U+001B has no named escape, so its canonical form is \u001b (bytes 5c 75 30 30 31 62), not \u001B. See jcs-n-esc-uppercase-contrast (vector 27) for the both-directions check.
